I'm checking whether unmortgaging St James would actually complete a monopoly, but since New York belongs to Gemini, orange isn't fully mine.

Similarly, Atlantic, Pennsylvania, and Baltic don't form monopolies since Gemini holds the complementary color-group properties, so unmortgaging just gives base rent without the doubled monopoly bonus. Given that, I'll go cheap and unmortgage St James for $99.
